# StargateAdapter
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/chain-bridge/src/adapters/StargateAdapter.sol)

**Inherits:**
[IAssetAdapter](../interfaces/i-asset-adapter.md), [IBridgeAdapter](../interfaces/i-bridge-adapter.md), ILayerZeroComposer, Nonces, [BaseBridgeAdapter](../base/base-bridge-adapter.md)

**Title:**
StargateAdapter

Adapter for Stargate V2 Protocol - all V2 contracts are OFT-enabled

Implements IAssetAdapter and IBridgeAdapter interfaces and connects to Stargate V2 for efficient cross-chain
transfers


## State Variables
### failedComposes
Mapping of operation IDs to failed compose details


```solidity
mapping(bytes32 => FailedCompose) public failedComposes
```


### failedOperationIds
Array of failed operation IDs for easier iteration


```solidity
bytes32[] public failedOperationIds
```


### LZ_ENDPOINT
LayerZero endpoint for compose functionality


```solidity
address public immutable LZ_ENDPOINT
```


### assetToStargateContract
Mapping of assets to their Stargate contracts on THIS chain only


```solidity
mapping(address asset => address stargateContract) public assetToStargateContract
```


### stargateContractToAsset
Mapping of Stargate contracts to their assets on THIS chain only


```solidity
mapping(address stargateContract => address asset) public stargateContractToAsset
```


### defaultUseTaxi
Default transport mode (true = taxi, false = bus)

Taxi mode is required for composability - bus mode does not support compose


```solidity
bool public defaultUseTaxi = true
```


### MAX_SLIPPAGE_BPS
Maximum slippage tolerance (10% = 1000 basis points)


```solidity
uint256 public constant MAX_SLIPPAGE_BPS = 1000
```


### MIN_SLIPPAGE_BPS
Minimum slippage tolerance (0.01% = 1 basis point)


```solidity
uint256 public constant MIN_SLIPPAGE_BPS = 1
```


### slippageToleranceBps
Default slippage tolerance in basis points (0.5% = 50 basis points)


```solidity
uint256 public slippageToleranceBps = 50
```

### constructor

```solidity
    address _lzEndpoint,

```

### mapEndpoint

Map a new chain-id → endpoint-id pair for LayerZero endpoints.

Governance utility. This only updates the local mapping; it does NOT
grant permission to send. That second layer of permission is still
enforced via the CrossChainRegistry.


```solidity
function mapEndpoint(uint16 chainId, uint32 endpointId) external onlyGovernor;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`chainId`|`uint16`|    Canonical EVM chain ID.|
|`endpointId`|`uint32`| LayerZero endpoint identifier (EID).|


### unmapEndpoint

Delete the endpoint mapping for a chain.


```solidity
function unmapEndpoint(uint16 chainId) external onlyGovernor;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`chainId`|`uint16`|Chain ID whose mapping should be removed.|


### transferAsset

Transfer an asset to a destination chain

Initiates a cross-chain asset transfer


```solidity
function transferAsset(
    bytes32 operationId,
    BridgeTypes.ExecuteTransferParams calldata params,
    BridgeTypes.BridgeOptions calldata options
)
    external
    payable
    onlyTrustedDestination(params.destinationChainId)
    onlyRouter
    nonReentrant;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|

|`operationId`|`bytes32`|Router-provided operation ID for tracking|
|`params`|`BridgeTypes.ExecuteTransferParams`|Parameters for the transfer|
|`options`|`BridgeTypes.BridgeOptions`|Bridge options including adapter selection and parameters|

### estimateFee

Estimate fees for a cross-chain operation (unified interface)

This method delegates to estimateTransferFee or estimateMessageFee based on operationType


```solidity
function estimateFee(
    uint16 destinationChainId,
    address asset,
    uint256 amount,
    BridgeTypes.BridgeOptions calldata options,
    BridgeTypes.OperationType operationType
)
    public
    view
    onlyTrustedDestination(destinationChainId)
    returns (uint256 nativeFee, uint256 tokenFee);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`destinationChainId`|`uint16`|ID of the destination chain|
|`asset`|`address`|Address of the asset to transfer (address(0) for non-asset operations)|
|`amount`|`uint256`|Amount of the asset to transfer (0 for non-asset operations)|
|`options`|`BridgeTypes.BridgeOptions`|Bridge options including adapter selection and parameters|
|`operationType`|`BridgeTypes.OperationType`|Type of operation (0=MESSAGE, 1=READ_STATE, 2=TRANSFER_ASSET)|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`nativeFee`|`uint256`|Fee in the chain's native token|
|`tokenFee`|`uint256`|Fee in the transferred token (if applicable)|

### lzCompose

Handles composed messages from LayerZero after Stargate token delivery

Called by LayerZero endpoint after tokens are delivered via Stargate V2


```solidity
function lzCompose(
    address _from,
    bytes32, // guid
    bytes calldata _message,
    address, // caller
    bytes calldata // extraData
)
    external
    payable
    override
    nonReentrant;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_from`|`address`|The originating OApp (should be destination Stargate contract)|
|`<none>`|`bytes32`||
|`_message`|`bytes`|OFT-encoded compose message from Stargate|
|`<none>`|`address`||
|`<none>`|`bytes`||


### _decodeOFTCompose

Decode OFT compose message header and payload
Layout: [8b nonce][4b srcEid][32b amountLD][20b composeFrom][bytes composeMsg]


```solidity
function _decodeOFTCompose(bytes calldata message)
    internal
    pure
    returns (uint32 srcEid, uint256 amountLD, address composeFrom, bytes memory composeMsg);
```

### _validateStargatePool

Validates that a contract is a legitimate registered Stargate V2 pool

Reverts with Untrusted if validation fails


**Returns**

### manualRecovery

Manual recovery for edge cases

When automated recovery isn't possible, governance can manually send assets


```solidity
function manualRecovery(
    address asset,
    uint256 amount,
    address recipient,
    bytes32 operationId,
    bool tryReceiveCall,
    bytes calldata customMessage
)
    external
    onlyGovernor
    nonReentrant;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`asset`|`address`|Token to recover|
|`amount`|`uint256`|Amount to recover|
|`recipient`|`address`|Where to send the tokens|
|`operationId`|`bytes32`|Operation ID to clear (optional)|
|`tryReceiveCall`|`bool`|Whether to attempt receiveOperation(BridgeTypes.OperationType.TRANSFER_ASSET,abi.encode( call|
|`customMessage`|`bytes`|Custom message for receiveOperation(BridgeTypes.OperationType.TRANSFER_ASSET,abi.encode( (if tryReceiveCall is true)|

## Events
### AssetSupported
Emitted when an asset support is added


```solidity
event AssetSupported(uint16 chainId, address asset, address stargateContract);
```

### DefaultTransportModeChanged
Emitted when default transport mode is changed


```solidity
event DefaultTransportModeChanged(bool useTaxi);
```

### SlippageToleranceUpdated
Emitted when slippage tolerance is updated


```solidity
event SlippageToleranceUpdated(uint256 newSlippageBps);
```

### ComposedAssetHandled
Emitted when composed assets are handled


```solidity
event ComposedAssetHandled(
    bytes32 indexed operationId,
    address indexed fleetProxy,
    address indexed asset,
    uint256 amount,
    uint16 sourceChainId
);
```

### ComposeCallFailed
Emitted when compose call fails


```solidity
event ComposeCallFailed(
    bytes32 indexed operationId, address indexed fleetProxy, bytes reason, uint16 sourceChainId
);
```

### TokensRecovered
Emitted when stuck tokens are recovered


```solidity
event TokensRecovered(address indexed asset, uint256 amount, address indexed recipient);
```

## Errors
### RefundFailed
Thrown when refunding excess native fee to `refundAddress` fails


```solidity
error RefundFailed(address recipient, uint256 amount);
```

## Structs
### FailedCompose
Information about failed compose operations for recovery


```solidity
struct FailedCompose {
    address asset;
    uint256 amount;
    address intendedRecipient;
    bytes32 operationId;
    address originator;
    uint16 sourceChainId;
    uint256 timestamp;
    bool isDeposit; // true for deposits to FleetProxy, false for withdrawals to CrossChainArk
}
```
